title: Rishipal v. State of U.P. [OFF-TOPIC: criminal bail, s.376 IPC]
docket: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10057 of 2005
headnote: OFF-TOPIC (mis-indexed in this corpus): a criminal bail application under Section 376 IPC with no electricity-law content. The applicant was accused of rape of a two-year-old child (FIR under s.376 IPC, P.S. Saroorpur, Meerut). On the facts and the medical evidence, and observing that FIRs in such cases are often not promptly lodged, the Court found it not a fit case for bail at that stage and rejected the application. Recorded only for corpus completeness; carries no Supply Code / Electricity Act ratio.
